description: This file contains SQL functions and procedures related to alarm management and time series cleanup in the Thingsboard platform, including creating, updating, acknowledging, clearing, assigning, unassigning alarms, and cleaning up time series data based on TTL.

methods.name: create_or_update_active_alarm
methods.description: Creates or updates an active alarm record based on provided parameters, handling insertion or update logic and returning a JSON status.

methods.name: update_alarm
methods.description: Updates an existing alarm's details; returns success status and alarm info.

methods.name: acknowledge_alarm
methods.description: Marks an alarm as acknowledged and returns the result.

methods.name: clear_alarm
methods.description: Marks an alarm as cleared, optionally updating additional info, and returns the result.

methods.name: assign_alarm
methods.description: Assigns an alarm to a user, updating the assignee if necessary, and returns the result.

methods.name: unassign_alarm
methods.description: Removes the assignee from an alarm and returns the result.

methods.name: cleanup_timeseries_by_ttl
methods.description: Deletes time series data older than TTL for tenants, customers, devices, and assets.
